item.title: 大语言模型学习笔记（一）：基础概念整理
About
item.description:
👋 Hi, I’m Darren

I’m a Large Language Model Algorithm Engineer at Ant International, focusing on AI applications for global financial systems.

My primary interests include:

  • Large Language Models
  • AI Agents
  • Financial AI

📝 About This Blog

This website serves as my public notebook.

I use it to document research papers, technical explorations, engineering practices, reading notes, and lessons learned from building real-world AI systems.

Rather than pursuing completeness, I focus on understanding concepts deeply, organizing knowledge systematically, and recording practical experience that may also benefit others.
